  • Save the experiment
  • Set the status of your experiment properly (it can be changed anytime, as necessary)

This template must be used to record every acquisition and processing of CT scans at the IMPALA

Instructions:

  • Please do not delete, add, edit, rename, or reorder any of the fields!
  • Create 1 experiment for each scan project
  • The title of the experiment must be the name of the scan project (= name of the PCA file)
  • Fill in all the required fields
  • Attach the PCA and PCR files of your scan to the experiment; the fields in the groups "PCA" and "PCR" will be filled automatically from these files, respectively
  • Attach the snapshot of the setup taken with the monitoring camera 
  • Save the experiment
  • Set the status of your experiment properly (it can be changed anytime, as necessary)
